subject.statement: René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025.

summary: The claim that René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025 is mixed: reliable Austrian outlets (DW, The Local) report a two‑year sentence, while several international outlets (Bluewin, Yahoo Finance) report a two‑and‑a‑half‑year sentence. No official court judgment was accessible, so the exact length remains uncertain.

findings.statement: DW.com and The Local.at reported on 15 October 2025 that René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison by the Innsbruck State Court (regional equivalent).
Bluewin.ch and Yahoo Finance reported on 22 September 2026 that René Benko was sentenced to two and a half years in prison.

conflict_notes: Conflicting reports on the length of the prison sentence: DW.com and The Local.at (weight 0.85 each) state a two‑year sentence, while Bluewin.ch and Yahoo Finance (weight 0.40 each) state a two‑and‑a‑half‑year sentence. The higher‑weight sources were given more credence, but the disagreement prevents a definitive conclusion, resulting in a mixed verdict.
